items.summary: Chipotle Mexican Grill (NYSE:CMG) plans to reintroduce its Smoked Brisket as a limited-time menu item in the U.S. and Canada from November 5. The smoked beef option returns as a seasonal protein choice, expanding Chipotle's core lineup of burritos, bowls, tacos and salads. The limited-time brisket offer is timed for the fall period and key sports weekends, when customer interest in new menu options can be elevated.
